required_mounts.go_toolchain: a Linux Go install for this machine's architecture, at the version in go.mod -- a macOS GOROOT will not run in the sandbox
required_mounts.go_mod_cache: the Go module cache, what `go env GOMODCACHE` prints
required_mounts.local_bin: ~/.local/bin, tools the build needs on PATH
required_mounts.rustup_home: ~/.rustup, holding a Linux toolchain for this machine's architecture with the wasm32-unknown-unknown target installed -- a macOS toolchain will not run in the sandbox
required_mounts.cargo_home: the cargo home, $CARGO_HOME or ~/.cargo -- registry/ is portable, bin/ must match the ~/.rustup toolchain
